test_instructions: Launch the validated fork local checkout executable at <PowerToysCheckout>\x64\Debug\PowerToys.exe.
Open Command Palette and browse the extension gallery.
Install a gallery JavaScript or TypeScript extension with a valid npm-shrinkwrap.json, then verify installation completes and the extension appears after refresh.
Uninstall the extension and verify its files and registered provider are removed without affecting unrelated extensions.
